report.title: 2025 Consumer Confidence Report - Valley View Ranches

sources_described: Groundwater: Well 02, located near the intersection of Fitzgerald and Green Valley Drive (Gilroy).
search_log: WebSearch "Valley View Ranches" Gilroy water system OR mutual water consumer confidence report -> only a geoconnex.us reference record (CA4300996, groundwater, population 45); no report

extraction_notes: Text PDF; pages verified from pdftotext form feeds (Table 1 on page 2; Tables 2-5 on page 3; the Specific Conductance row and Table 6 on page 4). Tables 4-5 have Min/Max columns instead of a range; only the nitrate row has a Max ('76*'), and the asterisk is unexplained because the report contains no violation table (it states only that the system did not operate under a variance or exemption in 2025). The nitrate value 4.11 is printed for both the as-N and as-NO3 rows. Barium is reported in ug/L against an MCL of 1,000. Hardness appears twice (Tables 3 and 6).
